Questions

Before you book a call

Straight answers to what businesses ask us first. Anything else, write to info@dakyx.com.

Do we have to sign up for a monthly partnership?

No. You can start with a fixed-scope project and move to a monthly plan later. You can also use a product such as Website Builder on its own.

Can you work with the tools we already use?

Usually, yes. We start with your current website, forms, CRM, WhatsApp and email. Then we recommend the simplest change that will help.

Do you work with businesses outside Kumasi?

Yes. We work remotely with businesses across Ghana and West Africa, using calls and screen sharing.

Do you replace our IT team?

No. We work on websites, automation, integrations and AI. We do not repair devices, install networks or provide managed cybersecurity.

What if we need more than our monthly plan covers?

We estimate the extra work and send you a written proposal. Nothing outside the agreed scope starts without your approval.

What happens if we decide to stop?

After the initial term, you can end a monthly partnership with 30 days’ written notice. Your domains, accounts, source files and data stay yours.
